definitions.explanation: The underlying support or foundation on which something is built or operates. Can be physical, economic, or abstract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基盤|きばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：00260_kyouka⟧。
